from pyspark.sql import functions as F

storage_account = "adls1tcba"  
container = "lakehouse"        

raw_path = f"abfss://{container}@{storage_account}.dfs.core.windows.net/bronze/ForExportNewApi.csv"
partitioned_path = f"abfss://{container}@{storage_account}.dfs.core.windows.net/bronze/tomtom_partitioned/"

# Baca file CSV mentah (1.23 GB) dengan inferSchema
df_raw = (
    spark.read
    .option("header", "true")
    .option("inferSchema", "true")
    .csv(raw_path)
)

# Ekstrak kolom 'year' dan 'month' dari LocalDateTime sebagai kunci partisi
df_partitioned = (
    df_raw
    .withColumn("parsed_time", F.to_timestamp("LocalDateTime"))
    .withColumn("year", F.year("parsed_time"))
    .withColumn("month", F.format_string("%02d", F.month("parsed_time")))
    .drop("parsed_time")
)

# Tulis ulang ke ADLS Gen2 dalam format Parquet terpartisi
(
    df_partitioned
    .repartition("year", "month")
    .write
    .mode("overwrite")
    .partitionBy("year", "month")
    .parquet(partitioned_path)
)

print("Partisi selesai disimpan di:", partitioned_path)

# Baca kembali folder yang sudah dipartisi
df_check = spark.read.parquet(partitioned_path)

print("Total baris:", df_check.count())
df_check.groupBy("year", "month").count().orderBy("year", "month").show(30)
